contents.text: {"hypotheses":[{"experiment_id":"carry","text":"Leo Marchetti’s actual pass (6.7% chance) was better than carrying the ball forward — carrying would have reduced the chance to 6.3%, so the pass increased the chance by 0.4 percentage points."},{"experiment_id":"pass_H11","text":"Passing to Jonah Pike would have been worse: that option gives a 5.5% chance versus the actual 6.7%, so Marchetti’s pass was 1.2 percentage points better."},{"experiment_id":"pass_H5","text":"Passing back to Ruben Saldo would have been marginally worse: that option yields 6.6% versus the actual 6.7%, so Marchetti’s pass was 0.1 percentage points better."}]}
